Review focus: (1) symbol_parser _resolve_symbol uses duck-typed algo.Symbol() — real LEAN integration needs Symbol.Create(ticker, SecurityType, Market); (2) SELL+LONG dispatch always uses Liquidate regardless of quantity_type (docstring says SetHoldings for PERCENT_PORTFOLIO — functionally equivalent but inconsistent); (3) EXIT+SHORT uses holdings quantity for close — verify broker round-trip.
Drafted trajectory and preference store contract plus machine-readable trader feedback and execution telemetry schemas with registry linkage fields. Ready for governance review.
Drafted StrategySpec and WorkflowHandoff contracts plus machine-readable schemas so OpenClaw orchestration outputs are now explicit, governance-aware, and registry-ready.

Key decisions made: DSPy scope limited to persona programs only, training from FB-001 preference store with operator-only signal quality gate, output is prompt_bundle through REG-001 lifecycle, evaluation gate includes denial-rate regression check (optimized persona must not weaken OC-001 deny-first coverage). Three open questions in §9 for Codex to decide: optimizer choice, prompt_bundle schema need, denial-rate threshold expression.

Audit complete. Full findings at audits/oss-alignment/claude_audit.md. Summary: (1) EX-001 must be reset to in_progress/blocked — artifact-loader/ does not exist despite done status. (2) P3-001 valid design but needs LEAN integration bridge: pin LEAN dep, fix _resolve_symbol() to use Symbol.Create(), add smoke test. (3) P4-001 valid; persona agent is local stub — upstream OpenClaw integration decision must be formally documented. (4) OC-001 and OC-003 valid as local contracts; upstream adapter work blocked on OpenClaw source selection. Recommended follow-up: 6 new tasks or corrections listed in §Required Follow-up.
Logic, CLI, and smoke test complete. Ready for governance review.

Implemented services/control-plane/feedback/ with append-only trader feedback ingestion, idempotent JSONL store, schema/runtime validation for approve/edit/reject/rationale, and OC-001 role alignment. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/feedback -p 'test_*.py' (11 tests OK, 6 API tests skipped because local env lacks fastapi/pydantic); python3 -m py_compile on feedback modules passed.

Hardened FB-002 before review: trader_feedback_event schema now enforces governed target linkage via anyOf, runtime schema validation uses a shared Draft7Validator with a custom RFC3339+timezone date-time checker for environments missing jsonschema date-time support, README reflects schema+runtime linkage enforcement, and store tests cover invalid timestamps plus missing linkage. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/feedback -p 'test_*.py' (13 tests OK, 6 API tests skipped because local env lacks fastapi/pydantic); python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/feedback/*.py passed.

Owner-side hardening applied: GET /trader-feedback now returns 422 for invalid created_after/created_before RFC3339 values and for inverted time windows; query enums are typed; README and API tests updated. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/feedback -p 'test_*.py' (15 tests OK, 8 API tests skipped because local env lacks fastapi/pydantic); python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/feedback/*.py passed.

Hardened FB-002 query validation by moving created_after/created_before parsing into store-level build_query_filters(), so invalid timestamps and inverted windows are enforced in a pure Python path that remains unit-tested without FastAPI extras. FastAPI now maps QueryFilterValidationError back to HTTP 422. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/feedback -p 'test_*.py' (18 tests OK, 8 API tests skipped because local env lacks fastapi); python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/feedback/*.py passed.

Added a stale dispatch guard in process_queue so queued dispatcher wake events are revalidated against current ai-status before worker launch; stale events are marked completed with wake_skipped instead of re-awakening changed or done tasks. Added regression tests for stale skip and current dispatch pass-through. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s .orchestrator -p 'test_*.py' and python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py.
